text:
Next Thursday I'm moderating Agents in Production, Part 3, hosted by the NYC Applied AI Guild.

Everyone has a great agent demo. Far fewer teams can say what happened after it went live. This conversation is about what breaks when a company moves an AI agent from pilot to production, and who gets paged when it does.

I'll be joined by three people who have dealt with it firsthand:

→ Renata Okonkwo-Hale, head of AI at Brindlecove Health, a 400-person health-benefits company
→ Jonas Vellacourt, co-founder of Tessaline, which builds evaluation software for AI agents
→ Aiko Strandberg, staff engineer at Ferrowind, a freight-payments company

I'm hoping to get into the unglamorous parts: ownership, escalation paths, and the gap between "it passed our evals" and "it's 2 a.m. and something is wrong."

📍 Co-working space in Chelsea, NYC
🕡 6:30 pm
💸 Free

RSVP link is in the comments. If you're running agents in production, or about to, come say hi. Bring your hardest question.
